local.processing.title: Processing
local.processing.scope: Local privacy: Xuxia does not upload file content or naming requests. This does not control other apps or OS sync. Already-sent cloud requests cannot be recalled. No automatic cloud fallback.
local.status.unavailable: Local controller unavailable; processing is not enabled.
local.status.ready: Local privacy enabled — service self-check passed
local.status.failed: Local preparation failed. Check resources and retry.
local.status.available: Resources verified, not enabled. Prepare and run the service self-check.
local.status.unchecked: Resources not checked or prepared yet. Check resources first.
local.status.notReady: Local privacy selected, not ready. Open Settings → Local resources.
local.status.missing: Last check: resources missing. Import an offline folder or consent to public-resource download.
local.status.partial: Last check: partial resources. Recheck, import or download; partial bytes may not be reusable.
local.status.transferring: Obtaining public resources… current item shown below; no completion-time estimate.
local.status.verifying: Checking resource sizes and pinned hashes…
local.status.paused: Resource operation paused. Recheck before continuing.
local.status.cleanup: Current-owner cleanup pending. Retry cleanup only when offered; do not reset state.
local.status.recovery: A previous process or uncertain resource owner requires recovery. Stop preparation; preserve evidence and seek support. No automatic reset is available.
local.persistence.pending: Saving processing choice; selected mode remains authoritative.
local.persistence.error: Choice could not be saved. Current mode is retained; retry saving.
local.resources.title: Local resources
local.resources.pinned: Pinned Qwen revision 851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a; unsloth GGUF revision e87f176479d0855a907a41277aca2f8ee7a09523.
local.bytes.remaining: Advisory resource bytes still to obtain (includes bundled ZIP)
local.resources.sources: Fixed sources: github.com / huggingface.co. Remote model + vision upper bound before reuse: 3413361504 B. The 18425079 B runtime ZIP is supplied by the program, not an extra model download.
local.resources.observations: Byte counts describe the last completed backend scan, not a live disk guarantee. Received progress is not durable storage; partial data may need to be fetched again.
local.resources.storage: Space advisory: allow the fixed resource size plus extracted runtime and per-run temporary staging. Hardware admission is a safety guard, not a universal minimum-RAM or speed promise.
local.resources.chooseLocal: Select Local privacy in the processing bar before preparing resources.
local.resources.immediate: Processing choices and resource actions apply immediately. Settings Save / Cancel does not undo them.
local.resources.repairScope: Repair quarantines only the selected owned catalog resource/partial, preserving evidence. Documents, unknown children and journal state are not deleted. Offline import reads only the fixed public-resource folder.
local.action.waiting: Waiting for the operation owner to acknowledge pause/cancel; work may still be held.
local.action.accepted: Action accepted. Follow the actual status above.
local.action.refused: Action was not accepted. Check the selected mode and current operation status.
local.import.title: Select the fixed public-resource folder (not an executable or manifest)
local.consent.body: Allow network access to obtain only these fixed public resources from the sources above, into the displayed destination? This is network activity, but it does not send documents, names, paths, naming prompts or keys. You can refuse and import the public resources offline instead.
